rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of interest / neutrality concern
rubrics_metrics.description: A major contributor to this article appears to have a close connection with its subject; it may require cleanup to comply with Wikipedia's content policies, particularly neutral point of view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss further on the article's talk page. Cleanup may include reworking tone, removing promotional content, and adding independent sourcing.
